## MKCinema 1.6: new Android player, Mac fix

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Android phones and tablets | `MKCinema.apk` (app 1.8.1) | Android 7 or later |
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV | `MKCinema-TV.apk` (the same file) | Android TV 7 or later |
| Windows | `MKCinema.exe` (app 1.3.0) | Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, Microsoft Edge WebView2 |
| macOS | `MKCinema-1.1.1-mac.zip` (app 1.1.1) | macOS 11 or later, Intel and Apple silicon |
| Linux | `mkcinema_1.1_amd64.deb` or `mkcinema-1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` (app 1.1) | x86-64, WebKitGTK 4.1 (2.40 or newer) |
| LG webOS (beta) | `com.mkcinema.app_1.1.0_all.ipk` | unchanged |

Every app loads the latest web app by itself, so everyone gets web 2.38 without reinstalling.

### Android and Android TV 1.8.1

- **New built-in player based on ExoPlayer**, on phones, tablets and Android TV.
- Installs over any earlier version and keeps your sign-in.

### Mac 1.1.1

- Fixes the app closing on start with "protocol does not exist" (#101).

### Web app 2.38

- **Mouse scrolling everywhere:** arrows and click-and-drag on every sideways list on a computer.
- **Signs & Songs with dubs:** anime dubs pick the file's Signs & Songs subtitles automatically.
- **Smoother TV remote** in the welcome tour.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/itbelikethatbruh/MKCinema/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for everything.

The Windows exe isn't code-signed yet, so the first run shows "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The Mac app isn't notarized: open it once, then go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway**.

**Fire TV:** in Downloader, enter `tv.mkcinema.app`.
